identificationModule.briefTitle: DAHANCA 33: Image Guided Dose-escalated Radiotherapy to Patients With Hypoxic HNSCC
identificationModule.officialTitle: DAHANCA 33: Functional Image Guided Dose-escalated Radiotherapy to Patients With Hypoxic Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck

leadSponsor.name: Danish Head and Neck Cancer Group

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Aim: To improve curability of radiotherapy in HNSCC patients identified by hypoxic FAZA-PET scanning
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
Prospective phase II study aiming to improve the outcome in hypoxic resistent patients identified by FAZA-PET.

Inclusion:

Patients must fulfill the following:

Positive hypoxic FAZA-PET Scanning (as described in DAHANCA 24 - see citation) Stage III-IV, Squamous cell carcinoma of the larynx, pharynx or oral cavity (HPVneg (oropharynx) Indication for hyperfractionated accelerated radiotherapy with concommitant cis-platin and nimorazole

conditions: Locally Advanced Head and Neck Cancer

armGroups.label: Treatment with HART-CN
armGroups.description: HART-CN: Hyperfractionated accelerated radiotherapy with weekly concommitant cisplatin and nimorazole

interventions.name: HART-CN
interventions.description: HART-CN: Hyperfractionated accelerated radiotherapy with weekly concommitant cis-platin and daily nimorazole

primaryOutcomes.description: loco-regional failure defined as persistent or recurrent disease in tumor and/or regional lymphnode sites (within the radiotherapy treated volume). The primary endpoint did not include the effect of a successful procedure with salvage surgery (no primary neck dissection was allowed).

secondaryOutcomes.description: Disease-specific death is defined as death from or with the cancer in question;

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Stage III-IV larynx, pharynx, oral cavity
* Hypoxic FAZA-PET positive
* Indication for primary radio-chemotherapy
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* HPV positive oropharynx cancer
* Primary surgery

locations.facility: Department of Experimental Clinical Oncology, Aarhus University Hospital
